purpose: T4E.8 slice 2: evaluate a band- and strength-independent definition of spatial identity. This design is fixed before this candidate is measured; it is informed by slice 1 and is exploratory, not confirmatory.
signature_definition: Pairwise Euclidean separation in this record's parent-grid cells, plus admitted principal-axis bearings. Translation, rotation and reflection preserve the configuration; rescaling does not. Detector band scales and coefficient strengths are carried only. No scale-free two-node shape is claimed.
held_out_forecast_period: 2022-2023 is not opened by this audit. The evaluation windows are within the existing training split and share its train-fitted climatology; this is not independent confirmatory evidence.
weights_basis: Keep the declared weights unchanged. The new signature has no comparable strength or scale block, so those weights have nothing to act on. No weight search is performed.
labels: Equal sorted track_ids within one tracking window; all distinct observations of a repeated key. Different keys are proxy negatives, including keys sharing a track. Neither label class establishes physical identity or nonidentity.
stationary_stratum: Exactly one observed cadence apart and maximum same-track displacement at most one parent-grid cell. No band condition is used for candidate calibration.
legacy_clean_stratum: Stationary plus no change in the per-track band labels, retained for comparison to slice 1.
radius_rule: Smallest observed stationary-pair distance admitting at least 90% of calibration-window stationary proxy repeats. Freeze that radius and apply unchanged in both evaluation windows. If no stationary pairs exist, publish NO_CALIBRATION_PAIRS and no radius.
acceptance_population: All repeated-key pairs, not just the selected stationary stratum, in each disjoint evaluation window. Both empirical error rates must meet the bounds. This is a necessary diagnostic, not sufficient scientific validation.
precision_reporting: Report pair counts and distinct contributing track keys; pairs are dependent. Report ceil(0.1*n) upper-tail observations rather than treating pair counts as independent sample sizes. Do not manufacture confidence bounds from iid binomial assumptions.
claim_boundary: No null is built, no mining radius is approved, no held-out result or scientific claim is produced, and no catalogue or event is signed by this audit. Original receipts and declarations remain unchanged. A failed discrimination criterion leaves T4E.8 and D97 open.
amendment_basis: After the first exploratory audit, add the monotone empirical feasibility diagnostic to distinguish a failed fixed radius from no feasible radius on these proxy populations. No threshold, window, weight or calibrated radius rule changes. This amendment uses already inspected data and is explicitly descriptive.
